provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address/copy data excluded; vertical retained; copy structure only.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A two-tier illuminated wall display on one steel bracket: face-lit pan channel letters with a black perforated day/night film over an internally lit 10in extruded cabinet with a polycarbonate face and gold/blockout vinyl.
knowledge.rationale: Letters-over-cabinet on a shared engineered bracket reads as one lockup; day/night film gives a black-day, white-night letter read.

structure.construction: face-lit pan channel, 5in black returns, 1in gold Jewelite trim cap, white LED, 3/16in translucent white acrylic faces with 1st-surface black perforated day/night film
10in deep extruded aluminum, 1in removable retainers, white LED, satin black; 0.150in translucent white polycarbonate face with blockout-black + translucent gold vinyl
3x3x3/16in steel angle bracket + welded 1x1 uprights, 3/8in stainless allthread through wall + steel beam, blocking at 3 columns (pending structural)

materials_manifest.product: black perforated day/night film + translucent gold

compliance.notes: NEC Article 600 / UL listed; Class II LV supplies, disconnect per raceway.

craft_observations: Day/night perf-film letters over a lit cabinet on one engineered bracket reads as a single lockup.
